title: Article on Brain Science and Art in IA#140
content: Currently in (#140 / August / Sept) ofInternational Artist Magazine, the first of a two-parter about what artists can learn from neuroscience.I explain how new discoveries in neuroscience can help us to see better and paint better. Learn about top-down vs. bottom-up processing and how the eye is different from the camera.Signed copies available on my website
